_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Galveston. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Galveston Island Historic Pleasure Pier
deals.deal: $2 off All Day Ride Passes with active military or VA ID
deals.details: Valid for up to four passes with a valid active military ID or VA ID card. Buy at the Pier Ticket Booth; not available online.

deals.name: Galveston Naval Museum
deals.deal: Free admission for active duty military with ID
deals.details: Children under 5 free. Open daily 9 AM to 5 PM, last ticket at 4 PM; Seawolf Park charges $10 per vehicle for parking.

deals.name: Galveston Railroad Museum
deals.deal: Free admission for active military and veterans
deals.details: Regular admission is $12 adults, $9 seniors 65+ and $6 children; children 2 and under free. Train rides are $8 extra.

deals.name: Moody Gardens
deals.deal: 20% off the One-Day Value Pass for military and first responders
deals.details: For active-duty military, veterans, their spouses and children under 18, and police, fire and EMS with valid ID. On-site purchase only at the Visitor's Center ticket counter.

deals.name: Ocean Star Offshore Drilling Rig & Museum
deals.deal: $35 family package (2 adults + up to 4 youth); $10 seniors and military
deals.details: Adults $12, youth 7-18 $8, children under 6 free. Open daily 10 AM to 5 PM, last ticket at 4 PM.

deals.name: Queen's Court Skating Rink (Hendley Green)
deals.deal: Tuesdays: one child 17 or younger skates free with each paid adult
deals.details: Seasonal rink in Trafalgar Square at Hendley Green, open November 28 through January 8. The free child skate is for the same session as the paid adult admission.

deals.name: Brew Chachos Tacos
deals.deal: Happy hour $1 off wells, house 'ritas and all drafts, Mon-Fri 3-7 PM
deals.details: Also $4 mimosas and $5 Bloody Marys and micheladas all day Sunday.

deals.name: Fisherman's Wharf
deals.deal: $10 bites, $8 frozen drinks, $5 domestic drafts, Mon-Fri 11 AM-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour bites include fish and chips, shrimp kisses, crab cake sliders and shrimp queso.

deals.name: Float Pool Bar
deals.deal: $3 wells, $4 rocks margaritas, drafts from $2.75, Mon-Fri 4-7 PM

deals.name: Tequila Rock Kitchen & Cantina
deals.deal: Happy hour bites: $4.75 tacos, $5 queso and chips, $9 fried jalapeño poppers, Tue-Fri 2-6 PM
deals.details: Bites are served in the bar area only and not for to-go orders. Happy hour drinks: $4 domestic and import beer, $5/$8 house margaritas, $4.50 wells and house wine, $7 select premium liquor.

deals.name: The Spot
deals.deal: Happy hour eats from $5: fried pickles $5, chicken tinga taco $6, chips and queso $7, diablo shrimp $10, weekdays 3-7 PM
deals.details: Happy hour drinks: $4 wells, $5 premiums, $6 signature cocktails and frozens, $1 off bottles, cans, draft beers and wines. Prices from the Galveston happy hour menu linked on the location page.
